meta.title: Wandit — Build mobile and web apps with AI
meta.description: Describe your idea in one sentence. Wandit builds a real mobile or web app with screens, sign-in and a database, and you try it on your phone in minutes.

hero.sub: Wandit designs the screens, writes the code and sets up sign-in and a database. Try it on your phone in minutes.
hero.stageLabel: Preview of an app that Wandit builds
hero.scanToOpen: Scan to open on your phone

howItWorks.title: From one sentence to an app on your phone.

steps.title: Describe it
steps.body: Write what you want the way you would tell a friend. In Arabic, French or English.

steps.title: Watch it build
steps.body: Wandit plans the screens, writes the code and sets up the backend. You see each step as it happens.

steps.title: Try it on your phone
steps.body: Scan the code and the app opens on your phone. Ask for a change and it updates while you watch.

steps.title: Publish it
steps.body: Put your web app live on a wandit.app address or your own domain. Build an Android app you can install.

demo.done: Your app is ready. Scan the code to open it on your phone.
demo.editDone: Done. The book button is gold on every screen.

layers.title: A real app, down to the database.
layers.sub: Most builders stop at the screens. Wandit also builds the parts you cannot see, so real people can use your app on day one.

screens.title: Screens
screens.body: Every page your users tap, scroll and swipe.

signIn.title: Sign-in
signIn.body: Email and password. Each user gets an account.

database.title: Database
database.body: Bookings, scores and messages, saved and in sync.

files.title: Files

server.title: Server code
server.body: Emails, reminders and jobs that run on their own.

languages.title: Your app speaks Arabic, French and English.
languages.body: Choose the languages when you start. Wandit writes every screen in each one and mirrors the layout for Arabic.

ideas.title: Need an idea? Tap one.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. You describe what you want and Wandit writes the code. If you do code, the code view shows every file, and you can edit it.
Mobile apps for iPhone and Android, web apps, dashboards, booking tools, landing pages and internal tools. If you can describe it, you can start it.

items.q: How do I try my mobile app?
items.a: Install Expo Go, then scan the QR code with your phone. The app opens and updates while you chat.

items.q: Can I put my app online?
items.a: Yes. A web app goes live on a free wandit.app address in one click, and you can connect your own domain. For Android, Wandit builds an app you can install.

items.q: Who can sign in to my app?
items.a: Your users. Wandit adds accounts with email and password, and keeps their data in your app's own database.
Every AI action uses credits, and you see what each one used. Start free, then choose a plan when you need more.
